name: Hostile Takeover
summary: Gelriz has been muscling out the moguls appointed by the trade princes and now makes a move on the most notorious pirate of all, and Baron Revilgaz will not stand for it. In response, Kebok in Booty Bay directs adventurers to steal strange blue crystals that Venture Company geologists have been finding near Lake Nazferiti.

sections.title: A Matter of Business
sections.body: Gelriz has stepped over the line by shoving aside moguls chosen by the trade princes and making a move on the most notorious pirate of all. Baron Revilgaz refuses to permit such insolence, instructing Kebok to handle the intrusion however he sees fit. Kebok's chosen response is outright theft, targeting the strange blue stones that Venture Company mining crews have been unearthing.

sections.title: The Geologists' Cache
sections.body: Venture Company geologists operating around Lake Nazferiti have taken a keen interest in these unusual crystals. Kebok wants eight samples brought back to Booty Bay, unconcerned with how they are acquired so long as they end up in his hands.

sections.title: A Tumbling Discovery
sections.body: Examining the returned specimens reveals that they have undergone a tumbling process, suggesting the Venture Company intends to utilize them as fuel or an industrial catalyst. Kebok intends to dispatch samples to Head Chemist Gigglefont for more detailed study.

faq.q: Who gives the quest Hostile Takeover?
faq.answer: Kebok, operating out of the pirate haven of Booty Bay in Stranglethorn Vale, gives this assignment on behalf of Baron Revilgaz.

faq.q: Why is Baron Revilgaz angry with Gelriz?
faq.answer: Gelriz pushed aside moguls who had been appointed by the trade princes and has now made a move on the most notorious pirate, which Revilgaz will not tolerate.
The crystals are carried by Venture Company geologists working around Lake Nazferiti.
